title: Object Digital Passport — passport.json v0.7
description: Machine-readable schema for the canonical v0.7 passport.json (SPEC.md §9, plus the edition anchors of §20). The minified, NFC-normalized, key-sorted bytes of this document anchor the on-chain dataHash; the `anchors` array is additionally anchored on-chain via anchorsHash + anchorTypesMask. Additional properties are allowed: SPEC permits optional namespaces (identifiers, iiif, sustainability, compliance) and additionalMetadata.

version.description: Document schema line. MUST be "0.7" for this schema.

passportId.description: On-chain Passport ID. YYYY-MM segments are the UTC mint month (SPEC §2).

title.description: On-chain card field. MUST equal the on-chain title byte-for-byte (1-128 bytes; maxLength here is a codepoint approximation of the byte limit).

authorName.description: On-chain card field. Human-readable author/brand name. MUST equal on-chain authorName byte-for-byte.

shortDescription.description: On-chain card field. One-line annotation (object kind, technique, creation year). MUST equal on-chain shortDescription byte-for-byte.

domain.description: On-chain card field (optional). MUST equal on-chain domain byte-for-byte, including the empty string.

description.description: Full description; free-text pre-registration history MAY live here (informative only, SPEC §9 provenance rule).

subject.description: What is depicted / what the object is about (Object ID 'subject').

creationDate.description: Object creation date or creation-period anchor (Object ID 'date or period'). Not the mint date.

anchors.description: Identification anchors bound on-chain via anchorsHash + anchorTypesMask (SPEC §9, §10).

status.description: Lifecycle state at registration. The current lifecycle status afterwards is the latest on-chain STATUS event, not this field.

idGranularity.description: What this passport identifies: a model (a design; any unit of it), a batch (one production run), or an item (one physical object). SPEC §9. Independent of `edition.model`, which describes how large the run is, not what the record points at.

translations.description: Language-keyed translations/transliterations of title, shortDescription, description. The on-chain card stays in the author's original language.

year.description: UTC mint year. MUST match on-chain mint inputs.

month.description: UTC mint month. MUST match on-chain mint inputs.

objectYear.description: Historical object year when it differs from the UTC mint year (SPEC §9).

localIso8601.description: Legacy name: value MUST still encode the same UTC instant with +00:00 offset only.

ianaTimeZone.description: Always UTC in reference privacy mode; device-local zones MUST NOT be recorded.

physical.description: Descriptive physical facts only (SPEC §9). Identification facts (dimensions, materials, marks, distinguishing features, seals, photos) belong in anchors[], not here.

then.description: SPEC §9 mixed object semantics: the canonical JSON MUST contain both physical and digital blocks.

wallet.description: Full 42-char wallet address. Truncated display forms are not valid here.

type.description: Anchor type (SPEC §9 anchor type registry): photo, dimensions, materials, distinguishing_features, marks, file_hash, perceptual_hash, c2pa, nfc, numbered_seal, fingerprint, dna, unit_key_set, unit_variant_commit, custom, or a future registry value. Bits 14-30 are reserved for future SPEC revisions, so unknown strings are intentionally not rejected here.

data.description: Type-specific fields (SPEC §9). Shape depends on `type` and is not exhaustively validated by this schema.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the type-specific content, when applicable (e.g. the photo file, the file_hash original, the c2pa manifest).

verification.description: Free text, or a profile id, describing how to check this anchor.

allOf.$comment: SPEC 0.7 §9 — dimensions. Measures carry a UN/CEFACT Rec 20 common code so software can compare them; a client renders the human-readable unit.

unit.description: UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 common code: MMT millimetre, CMT centimetre, MTR metre, INH inch, FOT foot. Every measure in this anchor is in this unit.

upperTolerance.description: How much larger than the stated measures the object may be and still match, in the same unit.

lowerTolerance.description: How much smaller than the stated measures the object may be and still match, in the same unit.

allOf.$comment: SPEC 0.7 §20.3 — unit_key_set. B profiles only; the same Merkle root is registered on-chain in ODPEditionUnits and a verifier compares the two.

labelSignerKey.description: SPEC 0.7 §20.7 — address whose signature an offline reader checks a signed outer label against. Omit for plain labels.

allOf.$comment: SPEC 0.7 §20.4 — unit_variant_commit. The salt is carried inside the sealed package and never appears here.
